newsitem.title: USA: SouthCap offers to buy United Home.
newsitem.headline: SouthCap offers to buy United Home.

text.p: Life insurance holding company SouthCap Corp said Tuesday it had offered to buy United Home Life Insurance Co at a cash price of $4.50 a share.
SouthCap said its offer, which will expire on May 20, was subject to it receiving at least 50.1 percent of United Home's outstanding common stock.
It said it would use "available resources" to finance the offer.
SouthCap said it already owned 3.6 percent of United Home Life and held the right to buy another 2.8 percent.
United Home, an Indiana insurance company, has about 1.2 million shares, it added.
An official at United Home said the insurer deemed the offering price to be too low.
"Our management considers it to be below what the company is worth," he said.
